sloka: शर जाल आवृतः सूर्यो न तदा स्म प्रकाशते ।अन्योन्य वध संरम्भात् उभयोः संप्रयुध्यतोः ॥३-२८-९॥
transliteration: śara jāla āvṛtaḥ sūryo na tadā sma prakāśate ।anyonya vadha saṁrambhāt ubhayoḥ saṁprayudhyatoḥ ॥3-28-9॥

translations.english: While they were engaged in the battle, eager to kill each other the sky was covered with arrow and the Sun could not be seen.
